name: Timed Speed Challenge
summary: Standard questions with a countdown timer. Speed and accuracy combine to create a score, testing automaticity and quick recall.

aiGenerability.notes: Timer is a pure mechanic overlay on any question set. AI generates the wrapped questions (any type). Speed weighting is deterministic. Full AI generability.

duration.description: Time limit in seconds (typical 30-90s for sets of 5-15 questions).

questionMechanic.description: ID of the wrapped question mechanic (e.g., 'multiple-choice', 'matching', 'sequence').

questionCount.description: Number of questions in the challenge (5-20 typical).

questions.description: Array of question objects conforming to the wrapped mechanic's schema.

streakThreshold.description: Consecutive correct answers needed to trigger streak animation/bonus (optional, e.g., 3).

speedWeighting.description: Optional multiplier rules (e.g., 1s bonus for first 10 seconds, 0.5x after 60s).

failureCondition.description: What ends the challenge: time expires, N incorrect answers, or first miss.

ux.mobileNotes: Large countdown timer at top (36+ font). Big, tappable question area with clear tap feedback. Streak counter pulses on correct consecutive answers. Rapid micro-feedback (checkmark, color change) for each response.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Generous time limit (60-90s) for 5-8 simple questions. Colorful countdown timer. Celebration animation on correct answers.
ageAdaptations.11-13: Moderate time (45-60s) for 8-12 questions. Standard countdown. Streak counter visible. Speed multiplier (e.g., 2x points for sub-10s answers).
ageAdaptations.14-16: Tight time (30-45s) for 12-15 complex questions. Advanced mechanics: difficulty scaling, progressive multiplier, leaderboard integration.
